force_and_units: Use native P_I once in kN, verify P_J duplicate; deformation U1_m with frozen mm/1000 check; time s. No force sign flip, re-fit, Excel read or new record.

definitions.r: predicted_delta_d-(d-d0), equivalent to d_pred-d_obs with known d0
definitions.Delta_Us: a*(Fend^2-F0^2)/2; conditional spring storage using fitted k

outputs: Every record separately: total terms, cumulative maximum discrepancy/time, signed negative Dport interval count/min, all interval identity residuals. Keep full local interval ledger; lightweight summaries and worst windows for handoff. Never sum across records/devices as full88 energy.
worst_periods: Partition each original time axis into fixed disjoint 1.00s windows anchored at 0; retain final partial window. Save all windows and top3 per record by absolute signed energy discrepancy Dforce-Dport; also top3 original intervals per record. No posthoc window length selection.
arithmetic_checks: Both per-interval identity and independently summed endpoint-storage total identity, tolerances only floating arithmetic checks, not continuous error bounds. Product term should be nonnegative for alpha>0; do not clip negative Dport increments.
limits: Classical discrete product/storage bookkeeping, not new theory. Same fixed constitutive model underlies Dforce and r; agreement is not independent physical validation. Native port/version and true properties remain conditional. The terms are not certified continuous-integration error bounds or full88 viscous dissipation.
